transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Lately I can’t think clearly or concentrate the way I used to at work, and it feels like my mind just won’t stay organized. It’s making it really hard to keep up with my clients and formulas at the salon, and I just feel completely overwhelmed.
Have you struggled with these issues of focus and organization since childhood, or is this a relatively new change for you?

This is actually a relatively new change that started about two years ago when I transitioned from cosmetology school to full-time work. I used to pride myself on being incredibly organized, precise, and structured, so this struggle with my focus is a huge departure from how I've always been.
Along with these concentration difficulties, have you been experiencing a persistently down or sad mood, or a loss of interest in things you normally enjoy?

Yes, it constantly feels like there’s a heavy gray cloud sitting on my chest, and I wake up feeling sad and empty. I’ve also completely stopped going to my hiking club and volunteering at the senior center, because most days I just feel too blank to care about anything anymore.
Over these past two years, have you felt this sad and empty almost every day, or have there been periods of two months or more where your mood went back to normal?

I've felt sad and empty almost every single day since things started going downhill. I can’t really remember my mood ever going back to normal for more than a few brief weeks at a time over this whole stretch.
How has your sleep been over these past two years, and have you noticed any major changes in your appetite or energy levels?

At night, I often just lie in bed staring at the ceiling, and my appetite has dropped so much that I have to force down toast and my clothes are getting looser. My energy is completely gone too; I feel like I'm moving underwater, dragging a hundred pounds just to walk or lift my arms to blow-dry hair.
Before this difficult period started two years ago, did you ever experience another time in your life when you felt depressed, empty, or exhausted like this for weeks or months at a time?

No, this is the very first time in my life I've ever felt this way. Before I started working full-time at the salon two years ago, I was doing really well, keeping up with my routines, and had never experienced this kind of depression or emptiness.
During this two-year period, have you also been struggling with strong feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or any thoughts of death or self-harm?

Yes, I constantly replay tiny mistakes like using the wrong toner once, and I feel like I've ruined everyone's life just by existing and don't deserve my job or friends. There are also nights where I think it would be better if I didn't wake up, and I've pictured stepping in front of a train or taking all my meds, even though actually doing it still scares me.
Have these intense symptoms—such as the severe lack of energy, significant weight loss, and thoughts of self-harm—been this severe for the entire two years, or did they start out much milder?

No, they didn't start out this severe. When things first began about two years ago, it was mostly milder stress from trying to manage my busy schedule and workload. The severe depression, lack of energy, weight loss, and thoughts of not wanting to wake up have been consistently this heavy for a little over a year now.
During that first year when you were experiencing milder stress, did you also feel a low, sad, or empty mood most of the time, or did that depressed feeling only start a year ago?

That depressed feeling actually started about a year ago, rather than right at the beginning. During those first several months, I was mostly just stressed and overwhelmed trying to manage my schedule, but the heavy, empty feeling set in later as the pressure kept piling up.

Have you ever experienced periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—such as having unusually high energy, needing very little sleep, or feeling extremely happy and 'on top of the world'?
No, I’ve never experienced anything like that. My energy has only ever been really low or just normal, and I've never had times where I felt extremely happy or on top of the world.
To help me rule out other causes, do you have any known medical conditions, like thyroid issues, or are you currently taking any medications, alcohol, or recreational substances?
No, I don't have any medical conditions like thyroid issues that I know of. I also don't take any regular medications, and I don't drink alcohol or use any recreational substances.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a first-time major depressive episode that has been consistently severe for over a year. She reports a persistently depressed and empty mood, profound anhedonia, significant insomnia, marked weight loss with decreased appetite, severe fatigue, impaired concentration, excessive guilt/worthlessness, and active suicidal ideation. There is no history of manic or hypomanic episodes, and the symptoms are not due to a medical condition or substance use.
